home: A stone shelter north of Orziben, built into a hillside. Eleven small holes in the ceiling, deliberate.
appearance: Age unclear. Milky eyes that move constantly. Clumsy. Hands covered in small scars.
and_yet: Never loses anything. Always knows who is in the room before they speak.
wants: A student who won't flinch at what the other worlds look like.
oddly_also: Always working on a stew, and breaks bread with unseen beings.
recreation: Sitting very still, watching the worlds.
dreams: To find a portal at one of the twenty vertices before he dies.
anecdotes: Described the interior of a sealed Ilmenor vault in Imazuran in precise detail. He has never been inside it. The Ilmenor have not commented.
Walked off a roof once. Got up, dusted off, said 'that ledge is much lower in the fourth world.' Has not elaborated.
tragedies: All his friends live in other worlds so he only gets to see them through a glass, darkly.
pc_leverage: Will teach Chekkad that illusions are not fabrications but resonance — light and form bleeding through from adjacent worlds.
